title: Generic one-pager for UK and EU finance platform owners
brief:
Audience: the platform owner at a UK or EU financial services firm (up to 5,000 staff) that is hiring an AI-rollout role.
Output: a one-page sales asset (tier 2, generic for the segment) a seller can send after a first call.
Decision: which proof points lead the page, and what call to action fits a first meeting.

plan.rationale: Default plan for one-pager: positioning first, then the page. I added nothing and skipped nothing. The brief names the audience (platform owner at a UK or EU finance firm up to 5,000 staff, hiring an AI-rollout role), the output (a tier 2 generic one-pager sent after a first call) and the decision (which proof points lead, and which call to action fits a first meeting). The product file has approved claims; its headline line is flagged for Islam to confirm, so the positioning task must not treat it as final.
